action_project_workspace_cleanup_descrip: Project workspace cleanup runs before execution workspace teardown.
action_plugin_storage_removal_descriptio: The storage plugin will verify remote recovery and remove the workspace.
action_remote_compute_release_descriptio: Release the sandbox and keep the saved workspace files.
reason_no_local_path: Workspace has no local path, so Paperclip cannot inspect git status before close.
reason_path_missing: Workspace path "{{path}}" does not exist, so Paperclip cannot inspect git status before close.
reason_git_inspection_failed: Could not inspect git status for "{{path}}": {{error}}
reason_git_status_failed: Could not read git working tree status for "{{path}}": {{error}}
reason_git_comparison_failed: Could not compare this workspace against {{baseRef}}: {{error}}
reason_storage_inspection_unavailable: Workspace storage inspection is unavailable; data was retained.
reason_remote_unsaved: The workspace still has unsaved work or an unfinished writer.
reason_remote_saved_unavailable: The saved workspace is unavailable. Its remote files were retained.
reason_remote_save_incomplete: The remote workspace save is incomplete.
reason_git_status_unverified: Paperclip could not verify the workspace git status. Retry before destructive cleanup.
reason_shared_session_only: This shared workspace session points at project workspace infrastructure. Archiving it only removes the session record.
reason_remote_custom_cleanup_unsupported: Remote workspace close does not support custom cleanup or teardown commands.
reason_keep_project_workspace: Paperclip will archive this workspace but keep "{{path}}" because it contains the project workspace.
reason_linked_open_issues_one: This workspace is still linked to an open issue.
reason_linked_open_issues_other: This workspace is still linked to {{count}} open issues.
reason_shared_linked_open_issues_one: This workspace is still linked to an open issue. Archiving it will detach this shared workspace session from those issues, but keep the underlying project workspace available.
reason_shared_linked_open_issues_other: This workspace is still linked to {{count}} open issues. Archiving it will detach this shared workspace session from those issues, but keep the underlying project workspace available.
reason_stop_runtime_services_one: Closing this workspace will stop {{count}} attached runtime service.
reason_stop_runtime_services_other: Closing this workspace will stop {{count}} attached runtime services.
reason_dirty_tracked_files_one: The workspace has {{count}} modified tracked file.
reason_dirty_tracked_files_other: The workspace has {{count}} modified tracked files.
reason_ahead_of_base_one: This workspace is {{count}} commit ahead of {{baseRef}} and is not merged.
reason_ahead_of_base_other: This workspace is {{count}} commits ahead of {{baseRef}} and is not merged.
